data.title: Parametric Yantra Generator
data.description: SIH 2025 Winner — Parametric software to generate dimensions of ancient Indian astronomical instruments (yantras) for any latitude and longitude in India.
data.longDescription:
• Generates parametric dimensions for instruments like Samrat Yantra, Rama Yantra, Digamsa Yantra, and more based on geographic coordinates
  • Built for Smart India Hackathon 2025 under AICTE's Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) category
  • Uses Three.js for interactive 3D visualization of astronomical instruments and accurate sky simulation
  • Features realistic celestial body positioning for immersive astronomical simulation
  • Supports instruments calibrated for historical locations like Delhi, Jaipur, Varanasi, and Ujjain
  • Preserves and promotes understanding of India's rich astronomical heritage
data.joke: The ancient scholars strictly forbade pushing these cosmic calculations to a public repo.

data.title: Exam Proctor Platform
data.description: A 3-way proctoring system to protect from cheating in examinations, featuring AI-powered cheating detection using WebAssembly.
data.longDescription:
• 3-way proctoring system for comprehensive exam integrity protection
  • AI-powered cheating detection using WebAssembly (WASM) for browser-based real-time analysis
  • Detects eye and head movements to identify suspicious behavior
  • Valid candidate verification system with face recognition
  • Test creation and management system to send assessments only to verified registered candidates via email
  • Comprehensive report generation with cheating incident logs and candidate exam scorecards
  • Integrates seamlessly with Safe Exam Browser for secure exam delivery
data.joke: Publishing the source code for an anti-cheat platform is essentially writing a tutorial on how to cheat.

data.title: Portfolio Website
data.description: A personal portfolio website built with vanilla TypeScript, featuring a custom SPA router, blog system, and project showcase.
data.longDescription:
• Custom single-page application router without framework dependencies
  • Blog system with markdown support
  • Project showcase with filtering and detail views
  • Dark/light theme toggle
  • Responsive design with mobile-first approach
  • Fast page loads with client-side navigation
data.joke: Built from scratch because 'npm install react' felt too mainstream.
